name: Classic Margherita Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 250°C (482°F) with a baking stone if available.
Roll out dough to a 12-inch circle on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Scatter mozzarella cheese over sauce.
Bake on the stone for 10-12 minutes until crust is crisp and cheese melts.
Finish with basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and optional parmesan.
Slice and serve immediately.
image_description: The photo shows a classic Margherita pizza with a charred crust, topped with melted cheese, red tomato sauce, and fresh green basil leaves, served on a wooden board with a side of sauce and olive oil. The pizza is cut into slices, with one slice partially pulled away from the rest.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
directions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat oil and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add marinated chicken; cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce heat and add cream; simmer 5-10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The image shows a steaming bowl of Chicken Tikka Masala, a popular Indian dish, served in a copper-colored metal bowl with handles, garnished with fresh herbs and accompanied by a side of white rice and naan bread. The dish is presented on a dark wooden table, with various spices visible in the background.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
directions: Toss tofu with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Fry tofu until golden; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and vegetables; stir-fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to pan; add rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Cook 1-2 minutes until coated; serve with steamed rice.
image_description: The image depicts a bowl of vegetable stir-fry with tofu, accompanied by a side of white rice and chopsticks. The stir-fry contains a variety of colorful vegetables, including broccoli, carrots, and green beans, along with cubed tofu, all coated in a savory brown sauce.

name: Greek Giouvertsa Salad with Lemon-Oregano Dressing
directions: Toss romaine, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately.
image_description: The image shows a Greek salad with lettuce, tomatoes, cucumbers, red onions, feta cheese, and olives in a white bowl, accompanied by a spoon and a small bowl of dressing on the side. The salad is placed on a wooden table with a blue and white striped napkin and a lemon wedge nearby.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
directions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a pan; add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant and lightly golden.
Toss pasta with garlic oil, adding reserve water as needed.
Season, mix in parsley, and serve with parmesan.
image_description: The photo depicts a steaming bowl of Spaghetti Aglio e Olio, garnished with parsley and red pepper flakes, and topped with grated Parmesan cheese. The dish is served in a white bowl on a wooden table, accompanied by a fork and other ingredients such as olive oil, garlic, and chili flakes.

name: Distance-Glazed Salmon with Dill
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix honey, soy sauce, mustard, and dill.
Season salmon with salt and pepper; brush with glaze.
Bake 10-12 minutes until flaky; drizzle remaining glaze over and serve.
image_description: The image shows a beautifully presented glazed salmon fillet, garnished with fresh dill and served on a wooden cutting board with a fork and lemon wedges. The salmon is glazed with a rich, sticky sauce and sprinkled with various seasonings, creating a visually appealing and appetizing dish.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth or leave chunky based on preference.
Stir in cream and basil; season to taste and serve.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of tomato basil soup surrounded by various ingredients, including fresh tomatoes, basil leaves, garlic cloves, and a red chili pepper. The soup is garnished with basil leaves and herbs, and the surrounding ingredients are arranged artfully on a light-colored surface, accompanied by a recipe for "Classic Soup" in the top-left corner.

name: Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 tablespoon palm sugar or brown sugar
directions: Prepare noodles according to package; drain and set aside.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar to make sauce.
Sauté garlic in oil; add shrimp or chicken and cook through.
Push meat aside, scramble eggs in the pan, then mix with noodles.
Add sauce and bean sprouts; toss quickly.
Garnish with peanuts, lime wedges, and chili flakes if desired.
image_description: The photo is a top-down view of a plate of Pad Thai, garnished with large shrimp, green onions, and a lime wedge, surrounded by various ingredients such as garlic, chili flakes, and spices. The dish is presented on a wooden table, with bowls of additional ingredients and seasonings scattered around it.

name: Chickpea Falafel with Tahini
ingredients: Tahini sauce: 1/4 cup tahini, lemon juice, water
directions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, flour, and spices until coarse.
Form into small patties or balls.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water to desired consistency.
Serve falafel with tahini sauce.
image_description: The image is a visually appealing representation of a recipe for Chickpea Falafel, featuring a central plate with seven crispy falafel patties, accompanied by sliced onions, lemon, and herbs. The surrounding area showcases various ingredients and condiments, including chickpeas, tahini sauce, spices, and seasonings, arranged in small bowls and garnished with fresh herbs and lemon.

name: Beef Tacos with Salsa Verde
directions: Cook beef with taco seasoning until browned.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese.
Top with salsa verde and sour cream if desired.
image_description: The photo shows four beef tacos with salsa verde, sour cream, and cheese on a plate, surrounded by various toppings and ingredients. The tacos are arranged on a dark-colored plate, with a vibrant and appetizing display of food, including diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, and salsa in the background.

name: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
directions: Season steaks with salt and pepper.
Sear in a hot pan with butter until desired doneness (about 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare).
Add garlic and thyme during the last minute, spooning butter over steaks.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: The photo shows a pan-seared ribeye steak cooked to perfection and served in a skillet with thyme and butter, surrounded by various seasonings and ingredients. The steak is garnished with thyme sprigs and accompanied by cubed butter, with a knife and oil visible in the surrounding area.

name: Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric
directions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add cumin and turmeric, cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and water; simmer 20-25 minutes until soft.
Season and garnish with cilantro.
image_description: The image depicts a bowl of lentil dal garnished with various ingredients, including a slice of lime, sliced tomatoes, onions, and cilantro, and surrounded by additional spices and garnishes such as turmeric powder, garlic, and an onion. The bowl is placed on a beige cloth napkin, with a spoon resting beside it, suggesting a warm and inviting meal.

name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onions for garnish
directions: Whisk miso, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar to make glaze.
Brush cod with glaze and let sit 5 minutes.
Pan-sear or bake cod until flaky.
Fluff rice with sesame oil, top with cod, sesame seeds, and green onions.
image_description: The photo depicts a beautifully presented dish of Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice, featuring a glazed cod fillet on top of a bed of white rice, garnished with sesame seeds and green onions, and accompanied by a bowl of soy sauce and chopsticks. The dish is artfully arranged on a ceramic plate with a blue napkin, wooden spoon, and additional sesame seeds and rice in small bowls on the side.

name: Caribbean Jerk Chicken
directions: Marinate chicken with jerk seasoning, lime juice, olive oil, and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill or bake until cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Rest briefly and serve with sides like rice and beans.
image_description: The image showcases a mouth-watering dish of Caribbean Jerk Chicken, featuring four succulent chicken pieces glazed with a rich, dark sauce and garnished with fresh lime slices and herbs on a wooden platter. The surrounding bowls contain complementary ingredients, including white rice, salt, and red beans, which enhance the overall presentation of the flavorful dish.

name: Roasted Tomato and Basil Pasta
directions: Roast tomatoes and garlic with olive oil for 15-20 minutes.
Cook pasta until al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with roasted tomatoes, add water to loosen if needed.
Stir in torn basil and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The image depicts a plate of penne pasta mixed with roasted cherry tomatoes and fresh basil leaves, topped with grated cheese and seasoned with black pepper. The dish is presented on a rustic plate, surrounded by various ingredients such as cherry tomatoes on the vine, garlic, and basil leaves, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
directions: Fry paneer lightly until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion with butter, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream, garam masala, and paneer; simmer 5 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of Paneer Butter Masala, a popular Indian dish, garnished with onions and herbs, surrounded by naan bread, rice, and various spices. The dish is presented in a large bowl with a rich, reddish-orange sauce and cubes of paneer, accompanied by complementary ingredients and condiments.

name: Falooda (Dessert Drink)
ingredients: Cherries or shredded coconut for garnish
directions: In tall glasses, layer milk, rose syrup, soaked vermicelli, and sabja.
Add ice and garnish with cherries or coconut.
Serve with a spoon and straw.
image_description: The image depicts two glasses of Falooda, a popular Indian dessert drink, garnished with cherries, rose petals, and other toppings, and served on a decorative tray with various accompaniments. The glasses are filled with a layered mixture of vermicelli noodles, milk, and jelly, topped with whipped cream and decorative elements.

name: Shakshuka
directions: Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, paprika, and cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells in sauce and crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs set; garnish with parsley.
image_description: The photo is a vibrant and appetizing representation of Shakshuka, a North African dish, featuring a cast-iron skillet filled with eggs poached in a rich, spicy tomato sauce, surrounded by various ingredients and spices. The skillet is centered, with a wooden spoon resting in it, and is encircled by an assortment of colorful peppers, onions, garlic, herbs, and spices, as well as small bowls containing oil, salt, and other seasonings.

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans (or 2 cans, drained)
directions: Soak beans if using dried (overnight recommended).
Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add beans, bay leaf, cumin, and water.
Simmer until beans are tender (about 45 minutes for dried).
Serve over rice.
image_description: The image is an infographic that illustrates the preparation and presentation of Cuban Black Beans and Rice, showcasing the dish in a large plate surrounded by its ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions. The infographic visually guides the viewer through the cooking process, from preparing the ingredients to serving the final dish.

name: Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 500g sirloin or flank steak, thinly sliced
directions: Marinate beef with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger for 15-20 minutes.
Stir-fry in a hot pan 2-3 minutes until cooked.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds; serve with rice.
image_description: The image shows a plate of Beef Bulgogi, a popular Korean dish, featuring thinly sliced marinated beef cooked to perfection and garnished with sesame seeds and green onions. The dish is presented in a large bowl, surrounded by various accompaniments and ingredients, including bowls of rice, sesame seeds, and spices, as well as fresh green onions and a spoonful of seasoning.

name: Spanish Paella Valenciana
directions: Brown chicken and chorizo in olive oil; set aside.
Sauté onion and pepper; add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add rice, saffron, and broth; bring to boil.
Return meat, cover, simmer until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: The image shows a large pan of Spanish Paella Valenciana, a traditional dish from the Valencia region, filled with chicken, tomatoes, onions, and saffron-infused rice, surrounded by various ingredients and cooking utensils on a wooden table. The dish is garnished with rosemary and red peppers, adding to its vibrant colors and appetizing appearance.

name: Tom Yum Goong
directions: Boil stock with lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and shrimp; cook until shrimp turn pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; add chili paste if desired.
image_description: The photo depicts a steaming bowl of Tom Yum Goong, a spicy Thai soup, filled with succulent shrimp, mushrooms, lemongrass, and red chili peppers, garnished with fresh cilantro and a slice of lime. The vibrant orange broth is served in a white ceramic bowl, accompanied by a white spoon and a small bowl of chili paste in the background.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
directions: Grill or pan-sear chicken; slice.
Toss lettuce with dressing and croutons.
Top with chicken slices and parmesan.
image_description: The photo shows a Chicken Caesar Salad with grilled chicken breast slices on top of a bed of romaine lettuce, croutons, cherry tomatoes, and shaved parmesan cheese, all tossed in a creamy Caesar dressing. The salad is presented in a bowl, with a few utensils visible in the background.

name: Moussaka
ingredients: Bechamel sauce: butter, flour, milk, nutmeg
directions: Roast eggplant slices until tender.
Cook lamb with onion and garlic; add tomatoes and season.
Layer eggplant and meat mixture in dish; top with bechamel.
Bake until golden and set.
image_description: The image shows a baking dish filled with a layered Moussaka dish, featuring sliced eggplant, meat sauce, and melted cheese, surrounded by various ingredients and spices. The dish is presented on a wooden table, with bowls of bechamel sauce, spices, and seasonings nearby, suggesting a traditional Greek recipe.

name: Shoyu Ramen (Quick)
directions: Simmer broth with soy sauce and miso.
Cook noodles separately.
Assemble bowls with broth, noodles, meat, egg, and green onions.
image_description: The image depicts a steaming bowl of Shoyu Ramen, garnished with sliced pork, green onions, and boiled egg, served in a black bowl against a dark gray background. The dish is carefully arranged, with the ingredients artfully placed to showcase the rich flavors and textures of this popular Japanese noodle soup.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil; add shrimp until pink.
Toss with pasta, lemon zest/juice, and parsley.
Season and serve.
image_description: The image shows a plate of Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta, featuring cooked shrimp, fettuccine noodles, and sliced lemons on a beige plate, surrounded by various ingredients like lemons, garlic, and spices. The dish is presented on a table with a light-colored cloth, creating a visually appealing and appetizing scene.

name: Ratatouille
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add vegetables; cook slowly with herbs until tender.
Season and serve warm or room temp.
image_description: The image depicts a vibrant and colorful dish of Ratatouille, a traditional French vegetable stew, with a medley of sliced vegetables such as eggplant, zucchini, tomatoes, and bell peppers arranged in a bowl. The surrounding ingredients, including whole vegetables, herbs, and spices, suggest a fresh and flavorful preparation.

name: Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt
directions: Season salmon; sear skin-side down in butter until crisp.
Flip and cook to desired doneness.
Mix yogurt with dill and a squeeze of lemon; serve with salmon.
image_description: The image shows a plate of Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt, featuring two pieces of grilled salmon with crispy skin, served with a side of white yogurt sauce infused with dill and spices, accompanied by lemon wedges and fresh dill. The dish is presented on a rustic plate with a beige napkin and utensils, set against a gray wooden table background.

name: Thai Green Curry with Vegetables
ingredients: Assorted vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, snow peas)
directions: Sauté curry paste briefly in oil.
Add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Add protein and vegetables; cook until tender.
Season with fish sauce and garnish with herbs; serve over rice.
image_description: The image depicts a vibrant and appetizing bowl of Thai Green Curry with Vegetables, featuring a medley of colorful vegetables, tofu, and white rice, surrounded by various garnishes and condiments. The dish is presented in a dark brown bowl with a light brown rim, accompanied by wooden chopsticks and a spoon, set against a light blue-gray background adorned with scattered leaves and spices.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
directions: Cook rice in water until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt.
Pour coconut sauce over cooked rice and let absorb.
Serve with mango slices.
image_description: The image is an illustrated recipe for Mango Sticky Rice, featuring a bowl of sticky rice with mango and coconut sauce, accompanied by sliced mango and a recipe card. The illustration showcases the dish's key components, including a blue plate with a bowl of sticky rice topped with mango, a spoon with salt, and sliced mango, all presented on a wooden table.

name: Herbed Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Lemon vinaigrette: lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper
directions: Cook quinoa in water until fluffy; cool.
Toss with vegetables, herbs, and vinaigrette.
Chill 10 minutes before serving if desired.
image_description: The photo shows a bowl of Herbed Quinoa Salad, consisting of quinoa mixed with sliced cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, and parsley, surrounded by ingredients like lemon slices, olive oil, and a fork on a gray surface. The dish is presented in a white bowl with a brown rim, garnished with fresh herbs and accompanied by scattered quinoa and peppercorns.

name: Beef Shawarma Wrap
directions: Marinate beef with shawarma spices.
Cook beef in a hot pan until done.
Fill pitas with beef and vegetables; drizzle with sauce.
image_description: The photo shows a Beef Shawarma Wrap, featuring a pita bread filled with sliced beef, cucumbers, tomatoes, onions, and lettuce, accompanied by various toppings and sauces. The wrap is presented on a dark surface, surrounded by additional ingredients and condiments, such as hummus, tzatziki sauce, and spices.

name: Pesto Chicken Bake
directions: Season chicken and place in baking dish.
Top each with pesto, mozzarella, and tomatoes.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 22-25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
image_description: The image shows a baked dish of Pesto Chicken Bake, featuring four seasoned chicken breasts on a bed of spaghetti, covered in melted cheese, pesto sauce, and cherry tomatoes. The dish is presented in a white baking tray with a spoonful of pesto sauce on the side and utensils placed nearby.

name: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Dip eggplant slices in egg then breadcrumbs; bake until tender.
Layer with marinara and cheese; bake until golden.
image_description: The photo shows a baking dish filled with Baked Eggplant Parmesan, surrounded by various ingredients such as tomato sauce, grated cheese, and fresh vegetables. The dish is layered with breaded eggplant slices, tomato sauce, and melted cheese, creating a visually appealing and appetizing presentation.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add chickpeas and tomatoes; simmer 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.
image_description: The image depicts a vibrant and appetizing bowl of Moroccan Chickpea Stew, garnished with fresh herbs and diced tomatoes, served in a decorative ceramic bowl. The stew is surrounded by various ingredients, including chickpeas, tomatoes, olive oil, and spices, arranged on a rustic wooden table.

name: Crunchy Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix dressing ingredients.
Toss with shredded cabbage and carrot.
Chill slightly before serving.
image_description: The photo depicts a bowl of Crunchy Cabbage Slaw, surrounded by its ingredients and a recipe, showcasing a fresh and healthy salad. The image is a visually appealing representation of the dish, with the slaw as the centerpiece, accompanied by various bowls containing ingredients such as shredded carrots, chopped cabbage, and dressing.

name: Ceviche de Pescado
directions: Cure fish in lime juice for about 10-15 minutes until opaque.
Mix with onion, chili, and cilantro; season and serve.
image_description: The image depicts a bowl of Ceviche de Pescado, a dish made with raw fish marinated in citrus juices, mixed with sliced red onions, chopped cilantro, and red chili peppers, garnished with a lime wedge. The bowl is placed on a wooden cutting board, surrounded by additional ingredients such as whole red chili peppers, a halved lime, and a sliced red onion.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
directions: Sauté garlic and chili in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook through.
Stir in soy and fish sauces; toss with basil until wilted.
Serve over steamed rice.
image_description: The photo depicts a plate of Thai Basil Chicken, also known as Pad Krapow Gai, consisting of stir-fried chicken, basil leaves, and red peppers, served with a side of white rice. The dish is garnished with additional basil leaves and surrounded by various ingredients such as garlic cloves, peppercorns, and chili peppers, showcasing the flavors and spices used in its preparation.

name: Caprese Salad
directions: Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate.
Top with basil; drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
image_description: The image depicts a Caprese Salad, featuring sliced tomatoes and mozzarella cheese arranged on a white plate, garnished with basil leaves and drizzled with olive oil and balsamic glaze. The salad is presented on a wooden cutting board, accompanied by a fork and a small bowl of balsamic glaze.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
directions: Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add rice and toast 1-2 minutes.
Add warm broth gradually, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in pumpkin puree, butter, and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The image is an overhead view of a pan containing pumpkin risotto, surrounded by various ingredients such as onions, garlic, salt, butter, and a whole pumpkin. The risotto is divided into sections, with cubed pumpkin, thinly sliced red onions, and a pat of melting butter on top.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
directions: Melt butter; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add shrimp; cook until pink.
Squeeze lemon juice; garnish with parsley and serve.
image_description: The image depicts a sizzling skillet of Garlic Butter Shrimp, surrounded by ingredients like garlic cloves, lemon wedges, and parsley, on a wooden serving tray. The shrimp are cooked in a rich, golden garlic butter sauce, presented in a black skillet with a fork and knife on the side.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with pita or veggies.
image_description: The image depicts a bowl of Roasted Red Pepper Hummus, garnished with chickpeas, red peppers, and olive oil, surrounded by various ingredients such as salt, garlic, and pita bread. The hummus is presented in a dark-colored bowl, with a decorative swirl pattern on its surface, and is accompanied by an assortment of colorful peppers and spices.

name: Garlic Naan
directions: Mix ingredients to form dough; knead until smooth.
Let rise 1 hour; divide and roll into rounds.
Cook on hot skillet 2-3 minutes per side.
Brush with garlic butter and serve.
image_description: The photo shows a plate of Garlic Naan, a type of Indian flatbread, arranged in a circular pattern with a small bowl of garlic cloves in the center. The naan is topped with garlic and herbs, and is served on a plate with a fork and knife on either side.

name: Butter Chicken
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter.
Add chicken and cook until sealed.
Stir in tomato sauce and garam masala; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream; season and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The image depicts a vibrant and appetizing dish of Butter Chicken, presented in a blue bowl against a dark blue background. The chicken is cooked in a rich, reddish-orange sauce and is garnished with green leaves, onions, and various spices, creating a visually appealing and mouth-watering culinary scene.

name: Coconut Curry Lentil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add lentils, coconut milk, and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Season and serve hot.
image_description: The image shows a steaming bowl of Coconut Curry Lentil Soup, garnished with red chili peppers, onions, and herbs, surrounded by various ingredients such as turmeric, lentils, and lemons. The soup is served in a brown ceramic bowl on a wooden board, with a creamy yellow-orange color and a sprinkle of black seeds on top.

name: Gyro Wrap
ingredients: Gyro meat (lamb or chicken) or substitute with sliced chicken
directions: Cook gyro meat until browned.
Warm pita; fill with meat and vegetables.
Top with tzatziki.
image_description: The photo depicts a Gyro Wrap, a popular Greek dish, consisting of a pita bread filled with sliced meat, tomatoes, cucumbers, onions, and a dollop of tzatziki sauce. The wrap is neatly presented on a wooden board, accompanied by additional ingredients and a bowl of tzatziki sauce in the background.

name: Pollo a la Brasa (Peruvian Roast Chicken)
directions: Marinate chicken with garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 40-45 minutes until cooked.
Serve with lime wedges.
image_description: The image depicts a beautifully presented Peruvian Roast Chicken, known as Pollo a la Brasa, on a clay platter surrounded by slices of lime and various spices. The roasted chicken is golden brown, seasoned with herbs and spices, and arranged in a visually appealing manner.

name: Mango Salsa Chicken
directions: Season chicken and sear in a pan.
Top with mango salsa (mango, onion, cilantro, lime juice).
Bake 10 minutes to finish cooking.
image_description: The image depicts a plate of grilled chicken breasts topped with a vibrant mango salsa, accompanied by lime wedges and garnished with cilantro. The dish is presented on a white plate with a brown rim, set against a dark background that highlights the colors and textures of the food.

name: Rice Paper Rolls with Peanut Dip
directions: Soak rice papers; fill with noodles, greens, and protein.
Roll tightly; serve with peanut dip.
image_description: The photo shows a beautifully arranged platter of rice paper rolls with peanut dip, featuring fresh vegetables, shrimp, and noodles, surrounded by various accompaniments and garnishes. The dish is presented in a visually appealing manner, with a bowl of peanut sauce at the center, inviting the viewer to take a bite.

name: Beef Nachos
directions: Cook beef with seasoning.
Layer chips, beef, and cheese; bake until cheese melts.
Top with beans, salsa, sour cream, and jalapenos.
image_description: The photo depicts a platter of beef nachos, topped with ground beef, beans, cheese, sour cream, and jalapenos, surrounded by various toppings and condiments. The dish is presented on a wooden table, accompanied by a recipe card and additional ingredients such as salsa, guacamole, and shredded cheese.

name: Herbed Chicken Skewers
directions: Thread chicken onto skewers after marinating briefly.
Grill until cooked through, basting with oil and herbs.
Serve with lemon wedges.
image_description: The photo shows a plate of Herbed Chicken Skewers, with grilled chicken breast chunks threaded onto skewers, garnished with rosemary and onions, and served with lemon wedges and a side of coarse salt. The dish is presented on a gray plate, surrounded by scattered salt, peppercorns, and rosemary sprigs, creating a visually appealing and appetizing scene.

name: Coconut Shrimp Curry
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add coconut milk and vegetables; simmer 10 minutes.
Add shrimp; cook until pink and serve.
image_description: The image is an infographic illustrating the preparation of Coconut Shrimp Curry, featuring a large pan of the dish surrounded by various ingredients and spices. The pan contains a yellow curry sauce with shrimp, onions, and peppers, and is accompanied by labeled ingredients and spices, including coconut milk, curry powder, and various seasonings.

name: Herbed Mushroom Risotto
directions: Sauté onion and mushrooms; add rice and toast.
Deglaze with wine; add broth gradually until creamy.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of Herbed Mushroom Risotto surrounded by various ingredients, including mushrooms, cheese, herbs, and spices, arranged on a gray surface. The risotto is topped with sautéed mushrooms and garnished with fresh herbs, accompanied by a fork and knife to the side.

name: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
directions: Mix all ingredients into a smooth batter.
Cook on a hot skillet until bubbles form; flip and cook through.
image_description: The photo shows a plate with a pancake in the center, surrounded by various ingredients such as flour, butter, lemon, and milk, likely representing the preparation of Lemon Ricotta Pancakes. The ingredients are arranged in small bowls and scattered around the pancake, giving a sense of the dish's composition.

name: Egg Fried Rice
directions: Scramble eggs in a wok; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables, add rice, then eggs.
Season with soy sauce and scallions.
image_description: The image shows a savory dish of Egg Fried Rice, presented in a black pan and topped with four fried eggs, peas, carrots, and green onions, accompanied by two small bowls of soy sauce. The dish is garnished with sesame seeds and spring onions, and is served with a gold fork and spoon on the side.

name: Okonomiyaki (Japanese Pancake)
directions: Mix batter with cabbage.
Cook on a griddle; top with meat and flip.
Brush with sauce and drizzle with mayo.
image_description: The image shows a plate of Okonomiyaki, a Japanese savory pancake, topped with shrimp, mayonnaise, and sauce, served on a wooden table with various condiments and chopsticks. The dish is garnished with shredded cabbage and a sprinkle of seasoning, presented in a visually appealing manner.

name: Herb-Ceta Pasta with Lemon
directions: Cook pasta; reserve some pasta water.
Toss with lemon zest, juice, herbs, and olive oil.

name: Gado-Gado (Indonesian Peanut Salad)
ingredients: Peanut sauce: peanuts, palm sugar, tamarind, lime
directions: Arrange vegetables, eggs, and tofu on a plate.
Drizzle with warm peanut sauce and serve.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water
directions: In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar to make the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken until cooked through; remove and set aside.
In the same wok, sauté garlic, ginger, and dried chilies until fragrant.
Return chicken to the wok, add the peanuts and the sauce mixture.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
image_description: The image is a top-down view of a wok filled with Kung Pao chicken, surrounded by various ingredients and seasonings, including peanuts, chili peppers, garlic, and soy sauce, with labels indicating the quantities used in the recipe. The dish appears to be a stir-fry of marinated chicken, peanuts, and vegetables in a spicy sauce.

name: Mapo Tofu
directions: Brown the ground meat in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the spicy bean paste and peppercorns, stirring until fragrant and the oil turns red.
Pour in the chicken broth and soy sauce; bring to a simmer.
Gently add the tofu cubes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce.
Garnish with green onions and serve.
image_description: The image depicts a sizzling dish of Mapo Tofu, a traditional Sichuan cuisine, in a large pan, featuring tofu cubes, minced meat, and green onions in a spicy sauce. The pan is surrounded by various ingredients and cooking utensils, such as chili peppers, spring onions, and a wooden spoon, showcasing the dish's preparation and flavor profile.

name: Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 300g flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
directions: Toss beef slices with cornstarch and a splash of soy sauce; let sit for 10 minutes.
Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a wok and sear beef at high heat until browned; remove.
Stir-fry ginger for 30 seconds, then add broccoli, oyster sauce, and soy sauce.
Return beef to the wok and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Serve immediately.
image_description: The image depicts a vibrant and appetizing dish of beef and broccoli, presented in a large wok or frying pan on a wooden table. The dish is surrounded by various ingredients and seasonings, including oyster sauce, soy sauce, ginger, and cashews, which are labeled with their respective names and quantities.

name: General Tso's Chicken
ingredients: 500g chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
directions: Coat chicken pieces thoroughly in cornstarch.
Deep fry chicken in hot oil until crispy and golden; drain on paper towels.
In a separate pan, sauté ginger, garlic, and chilies.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar; simmer until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the crispy chicken into the sauce until fully coated.
Serve over white rice.
image_description: The image shows a plate of General Tso's Chicken, a popular Chinese-American dish, served with white rice and garnished with red chili peppers and sesame seeds. The chicken is deep-fried and coated in a sweet and spicy sauce, accompanied by sliced ginger and additional chili peppers on the side.

name: Pork Potstickers (Dumplings)
directions: Mix pork, cabbage, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger in a bowl.
Place a teaspoon of filling in the center of a wrapper, moisten edges, and fold/pleat to seal.
Heat oil in a flat skillet and arrange dumplings in a single layer.
Fry for 2 minutes until bottoms are golden.
Pour in water and immediately cover with a lid to steam for 5-7 minutes.
Remove lid and cook until water evaporates and bottoms are crispy again.
image_description: The photo shows a pan of pan-fried pork potstickers or dumplings, served with a dipping sauce in a small bowl. The dumplings are garnished with sesame seeds and scallions, and are arranged in a visually appealing way on a wooden serving board.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
directions: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add tofu, bamboo shoots, soy sauce, and white pepper.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and simmer until thickened.
Slowly drizzle in the beaten egg while stirring gently to create ribbons.
Stir in the rice vinegar at the very end to preserve the 'sour' punch.
Garnish with green onions.
image_description: The image depicts a steaming hot pot of Hot and Sour Soup, filled with tofu, bamboo shoots, and various seasonings, surrounded by bowls of ingredients and garnishes. The soup is being stirred with a wooden spoon, and the surrounding ingredients are labeled with their respective names.

name: Chow Mein
directions: Boil noodles according to package instructions, drain, and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry cabbage and carrots for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles to the wok.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar, then pour over the noodles.
Toss at high heat for 2-3 minutes until noodles are slightly charred and well coated.
Serve hot.
image_description: The image depicts a plate of Chow Mein, a Chinese stir-fry dish, featuring noodles mixed with various vegetables such as carrots, broccoli, and cabbage, served with chopsticks and accompanied by two bowls of sauce. The dish is presented on a large, shallow plate with a brown rim, placed on a gray surface with a napkin and scattered spices.

name: Wonton Soup
directions: Bring chicken broth and soy sauce to a boil in a pot.
Add the wontons and simmer for 5 minutes (or until they float).
Add bok choy and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Turn off heat and stir in sesame oil.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with green onions.
image_description: The image shows three bowls of wonton soup with bok choy and scallions, accompanied by various seasonings and ingredients on a wooden tray. The bowls are arranged on a wooden tray, surrounded by small bowls containing soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, pepper, and other seasonings, as well as chopped scallions and bok choy.

name: Honey Walnut Shrimp
directions: Dip shrimp in egg, then coat with cornstarch.
Fry shrimp in hot oil until golden and crispy; drain.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, honey, and condensed milk.
Toss the warm shrimp and candied walnuts into the sauce until evenly coated.
Serve immediately, usually garnished with steamed broccoli.
image_description: The image depicts a plate of Honey Walnut Shrimp, featuring succulent shrimp coated in a sweet and creamy sauce, accompanied by broccoli florets, walnuts, and quail eggs. The dish is presented in a blue ceramic bowl with a brown rim, set against a light blue background with a few stray walnuts scattered nearby.
